summary: SandRidge Energy filed an 8-K reporting an 8% increase in its ongoing quarterly dividend to $0.13 per share and a one-time dividend of $0.20 per share, both payable June 1, 2026 to holders of record May 20, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or shares under the existing Dividend Reinvestment Plan. The board approved the increase and special dividend, reflecting a return of capital to shareholders. No advisors or regulatory clocks were cited. The company had $104.1 million cash at quarter-end. Watch for future dividend sustainability and potential special dividends as cash flow allows.
